newsitem.title: USA: Intevac sees 2nd half revs equal to first.
newsitem.headline: Intevac sees 2nd half revs equal to first.

text.p: Intevac Inc expects second half revenues to match the $64.9 million reported for the first six months of 1997.

"Looking ahead, our backlog indicates second half revenues should be about equal to the first half, but with customer requirements concentrated in the fourth quarter," said Intevac chief executive officer Norman Pond.

Pond said research and development spending in the second half will be sharply higher than the first half. The continued R&D investment without the benefit of cost sharing credits will have a negative impact on second half earnings, but Intevac plans to continue the programs as they are critical.
